to.status: New local breaking draft. Namespace is unregistered and context is unhosted. No deployment, endorsement, native binding implementation or v0.1 conformance is asserted.

compatibility: Breaking IRI and contract migration; no owl:sameAs, alias migration or v0.1 conformance claim.
evidence_convention: Mapping evidence source:line-range resolves under source_locations, never under the rewritten active file.

new_properties.name: accepts
new_properties.uses: InputRequirement -> JSON Schema object carried as RDF JSON, 1..1
new_properties.meaning: Requested incoming Mode-description contract at the application's delivered interface.
new_properties.how: Declare JSON Schema 2020-12 with $schema; JSON-LD coercion is @json. Validate a normalized whole Mode description, not a media payload or TD DataSchema node.
new_properties.absence: Missing is invalid. A schema with only $schema deliberately constrains no further descriptor facts; it does not authorize operations.
new_properties.default: No default injection. Hard fields require standard required. Unresolved $ref prevents a compatibility conclusion.
new_properties.limit: Exact reduced Rational pairs may be enumerated; generic rational inequalities/cross-field arithmetic are not automatically expressible.

new_properties.name: result
new_properties.meaning: Selected native producer interaction whose DataSchema defines the declared result payload.
new_properties.how: Reference a producer property, Action output or Event data Form. Resolve schema/media type from its native affordance and Form, not a copied AV schema.
new_properties.absence: No result contract specified; do not infer no output, arbitrary output compatibility, successful completion, or durable commitment.
new_properties.limit: A multi-output payload uses its native schema; this core does not add output-slot routing or delivery lifecycle classes.

new_properties.name: destination
new_properties.uses: Need -> FormReference, 0..1; requires result when present
new_properties.meaning: Requested receiver of the declared result.
new_properties.authority: workload_author selects; destination_owner defines native input/access
new_properties.how: Choose a writable-property or Action input Form. Native processor interaction must explicitly support this sink and supply its required parameters.
new_properties.absence: No push destination requested; use selected result access. No implicit callback, default sink or broadcast.
new_properties.limit: Reference metadata is neither a routing instruction by itself nor authorization, delivery success or durability evidence.

retained_contract_changes.Offer: Remove mandatory AV resource/configuration qualification dependencies from the offered-mode contract.
retained_contract_changes.Mode: Joint representation is retained; generic acquisition/resource pins and an AV Clip selector are no longer required.
retained_contract_changes.Track: An explicit converter publishes its own output Track; no wire/delivered TrackRequirement join or mandatory configuration pin.
retained_contract_changes.Rational: Only the frame-rate use remains in core; no clock/selector/bounds framework.
retained_contract_changes.Need: Remove generation/state obligations and mandatory PROV subclass/series/pin framework; v0.1 conformance is not claimed.
retained_contract_changes.InputRequirement: Replace InputAlternative/TrackRequirement/typed-constraint nodes with standard JSON Schema.
retained_contract_changes.FormReference: Remove DocumentPin and acceptance/immutable-byte guarantees; original v0.1 record is not silently weakened.
retained_contract_changes.source: Range is native Thing, not a mandatory MediaSource role class.
retained_contract_changes.kind: Remove mandatory AV clip timeline/selector structure; native media mechanisms own extents and selection.
retained_contract_changes.processor: Native Thing range; target is no longer mandatory for a portable workload description.
retained_contract_changes.document: Rehome the retrieval concept from DocumentPin; URI/version/cache metadata is not an immutable-byte or authenticity guarantee.

mapping_legend.keep: Name remains in the candidate core. Read candidate entry for explicit 0.2 range/cardinality/meaning changes and IRI migration.
mapping_legend.delegate: Remove this AV term from active core. An existing native/application/schema/artifact mechanism owns the requirement; it is not a renamed mandatory AV profile.
mapping_legend.remove: Remove the generic mechanism from active core without a standardized replacement or implicit behavioral default.
mapping_legend.all_old_entries: Preserve original definitions and artifacts only in the v0.1-proposed archive.

class_mapping.name: MediaSource
class_mapping.reason: Source identity needs no AV subclass; the Offer's source identifies a physical or logical native Thing.

class_mapping.name: Connector
class_mapping.reason: Acquisition/adaptation is implemented by the native adapter, not a mandatory role ontology or host/backend profile.

class_mapping.name: Processor
class_mapping.reason: A processing Thing already exposes input/output operations; worker/model identity remains distinct without a role class.

class_mapping.name: Controller
class_mapping.reason: Coordination can be application-specific native interactions; no universal controller protocol is required.

class_mapping.name: Offer
class_mapping.reason: Portable discovery needs a source's alternative complete media offers without copying endpoints.

class_mapping.name: Mode
class_mapping.reason: Joint representation/track combinations prevent false Cartesian-product capabilities; resource and pin machinery is removed explicitly.

class_mapping.name: Track
class_mapping.reason: Simultaneous video/audio components need stable names and actual representation facts.

class_mapping.name: ResourceUse
class_mapping.reason: Capacity, configuration sharing and allocation are native operational concerns, not prerequisite media-description records.

class_mapping.name: Rational
class_mapping.reason: Exact frame rates are useful portable facts; preserve fraction precision without a clock/selector framework.

class_mapping.name: Need
class_mapping.reason: Portable desired-work descriptions are needed, but generations, state, pins and current heads are not.

class_mapping.name: InputRequirement
class_mapping.reason: Named multi-input workloads and explicit optionality remain useful after removing custom constraint nodes.

class_mapping.name: InputAlternative
class_mapping.reason: Whole-contract alternatives are standard schema disjunction, not a separate identified AV node hierarchy.

class_mapping.name: TrackRequirement
class_mapping.reason: Application delivery uses one incoming interface; source and converter output Offers replace joined wire/delivered requirement graphs.

class_mapping.name: IntegerConstraint
class_mapping.reason: Standard integer predicates already express these constraints with explicit required-field semantics.

class_mapping.name: RationalConstraint
class_mapping.target: Exact-pair schema choices or explicit application validation
class_mapping.reason: Do not retain a generic range evaluator; schema alone cannot compare rational quotients or justify rounded-rate substitutions.

class_mapping.name: ChoiceConstraint
class_mapping.reason: Membership is standard schema validation; host/backend placement belongs to deployment rather than new AV constraints.

class_mapping.name: Preference
class_mapping.target: Application-local selection policy, not standardized in core
class_mapping.reason: Lexicographic ranking and tie-breaking are optimizer policy, not necessary portable input-description semantics.

class_mapping.name: InputGroup
class_mapping.reason: All-or-none multi-input admission and synchronization introduce orchestration promises beyond this descriptive core.

class_mapping.name: QueuePolicy
class_mapping.reason: Buffering and dropping policies belong to an actual implementation; no universal queue graph or lossless default.

class_mapping.name: TimingConstraint
class_mapping.target: Application SLA and native timing semantics
class_mapping.reason: Worst-case age/skew require qualified clocks and measurement scope, not generic metadata bounds.

class_mapping.name: TimeSelector
class_mapping.target: Native media/container extent and seek/range interaction
class_mapping.reason: The core offers whole finite Clips; exact interval acquisition/seek semantics are not universally portable.

class_mapping.name: TimestampMapping
class_mapping.target: Native media/clock protocol and qualified adapter
class_mapping.reason: Affine clock maps, drift and incarnation handling should not be rebuilt as an AV framework.

class_mapping.name: Timestamp
class_mapping.reason: A general observed-time/evidence ontology is unnecessary for advertising media and application input contracts.

class_mapping.name: DocumentPin
class_mapping.target: TD retrieval/version/cache plus existing artifact integrity mechanisms
class_mapping.reason: Delete transitive digest-closure obligations; preserve retrieval identity without claiming immutable bytes or authenticity.

class_mapping.name: FormReference
class_mapping.reason: Named native Form/operation selection is the useful seam; replace mandatory pin with explicit TD document location.

class_mapping.name: Assignment
class_mapping.reason: A small actual accepted-choice record need not import initial grants, lifecycle, dependency pins or a new AV class.

class_mapping.name: InputSelection
class_mapping.reason: Named input-to-Mode/Form choices are ordinary interaction data, not mandatory qualified adapter-plan records.

class_mapping.name: TrackSelection
class_mapping.target: Native processor input mapping if required
class_mapping.reason: Joined wire/delivered TrackRequirement mapping disappears when processing output is a separate offered interface.

class_mapping.name: AssignmentStatus
class_mapping.reason: Application status should not require immutable observations, observer sequences, grants and four fixed condition records.

class_mapping.name: LeaseGrant
class_mapping.reason: A generic lease renewal/fencing authority framework is unrelated to minimal media-description interoperability.

class_mapping.name: Condition
class_mapping.reason: Four-valued readiness/evidence bundles are controller policy; absence must not fabricate a condition truth.

class_mapping.name: Fault
class_mapping.target: Native error response and application payload schema
class_mapping.reason: Keep explicit errors without a universal closed AV failure taxonomy.

class_mapping.name: MediaAsset
class_mapping.target: Existing storage/artifact metadata and native media Forms
class_mapping.reason: Retained content and optional PROV links need no mandatory sealed-media manifest class.

class_mapping.name: MediaSample
class_mapping.reason: A universal source/incarnation/sequence/selector identity model is not required for the application-facing description.

class_mapping.name: InferenceModel
class_mapping.target: Existing model format and artifact/registry reference
class_mapping.reason: Weights, tensors, files, runtime and preprocessing remain model/application concerns, distinct from WoT Thing Models.

class_mapping.name: ResultContract
class_mapping.target: Native result DataSchema/Form plus result/destination selections
class_mapping.reason: Payload schema and destination do not require a pinned manifest, deduplication protocol or commitment contract.

class_mapping.name: Result
class_mapping.target: Native output payload schema and optional external metadata
class_mapping.reason: Do not force every output into a PROV entity with payload pin and authenticated durable receipt.

class_mapping.name: ProcessingRun
class_mapping.target: Optional prov:Activity or native execution record
class_mapping.reason: Existing PROV describes actual runs when needed; planning descriptions do not imply use or generation.

property_mapping.name: offer
property_mapping.reason: Native Things need a portable link to complete media alternatives, without duplicated endpoints.

property_mapping.name: need
property_mapping.reason: Link desired application input contracts without the old Assignment/current-head protocol.

property_mapping.name: source
property_mapping.reason: Preserve physical/logical Thing identity; remove mandatory AV role typing and MediaSample domain.

property_mapping.name: connector
property_mapping.target: Native Thing links and adapter deployment
property_mapping.reason: The real adapter exposes its own Thing/Forms; no universal source-to-connector role graph is required.

property_mapping.name: host
property_mapping.reason: Host-local execution placement is not a generic media attribute; preserve locality requirements in the actual access mechanism.

property_mapping.name: backend
property_mapping.reason: Driver/runtime qualification belongs to the implementation rather than a mandatory AV backend profile.

property_mapping.name: locality
property_mapping.reason: No new Form annotation is required; network reachability or host-local executability must not be inferred from omission.

property_mapping.name: binding
property_mapping.target: TD Forms, protocol-binding vocabulary and standard links
property_mapping.reason: Avoid a second mandatory binding identity plus pinned AV qualification; native protocol support remains explicit.

property_mapping.name: mediaDirection
property_mapping.target: Native media-leg negotiation and optional derived registry projection
property_mapping.reason: Direction is a real protocol fact, not HTTP request direction; do not require a universal media-Form annotation.

property_mapping.name: mode
property_mapping.reason: Joint complete alternatives are essential to prevent fabricated Cartesian-product capabilities.

property_mapping.name: kind
property_mapping.reason: Live, Still and whole finite Clip are portable distinctions; no AV capture or selector operation is implied.

property_mapping.name: form
property_mapping.reason: Named native Form identity is useful and remains distinct from its transport target.

property_mapping.name: track
property_mapping.reason: Preserve complete simultaneous components; remove wire/delivered selection and sample domains.

property_mapping.name: resourceUses
property_mapping.reason: Do not force every descriptive Mode to enumerate a complete resource/fencing graph.

property_mapping.name: resource
property_mapping.reason: A configuration/fencing domain is not an application media-description primitive.

property_mapping.name: configuration
property_mapping.target: Native device/codec negotiation, processor TD parameters and existing artifact metadata
property_mapping.reason: Remove the multipurpose typed-pin escape hatch; do not rebuild camera encoder/control or mandatory adapter-plan documents.

property_mapping.name: sharing
property_mapping.reason: Exact shared-configuration allocation is operational policy, not proved by descriptive metadata.

property_mapping.name: representation
property_mapping.reason: The actual encoded/raw family is portable; an explicit converter's output is separately described.

property_mapping.name: width
property_mapping.reason: Actual image width is useful read-only metadata, not an exposure/encoder setter or sensor maximum.

property_mapping.name: height
property_mapping.reason: Actual image height is a portable fact and must not imply an automatic resize operation.

property_mapping.name: codec
property_mapping.reason: Retain coding-family facts without asserting decoder qualification or duplicating native encoder settings.

property_mapping.name: pixelFormat
property_mapping.reason: Applications need known pixel order/packing; native format mapping is read-only and never guessed.

property_mapping.name: cadence
property_mapping.reason: Constant/Variable/Triggered distinguishes actual media cadence, without exposing trigger controls.

property_mapping.name: frameRate
property_mapping.reason: Exact media cadence matters; it is neither a camera setter nor guaranteed application throughput after loss.

property_mapping.name: sampleRate
property_mapping.reason: Actual audio sampling frequency is a portable input fact and not a transport clock default.

property_mapping.name: channels
property_mapping.reason: Actual audio channel count is necessary for an unambiguous audio description.

property_mapping.name: channelLayout
property_mapping.reason: Channel meaning/order cannot safely be inferred from count or buffer interleaving.

property_mapping.name: sampleFormat
property_mapping.reason: PCM numeric representation is a portable application-facing fact.

property_mapping.name: bufferLayout
property_mapping.reason: Keep the raw/PCM layout category, but detailed native memory semantics are not implied by it.

property_mapping.name: timing
property_mapping.target: Native media timestamps and optional payload metadata
property_mapping.reason: A generic mapping/evidence graph should not be required for basic media representation discovery.

property_mapping.name: numerator
property_mapping.reason: Retain exact Rational values rather than rounded decimal frame rates.

property_mapping.name: denominator
property_mapping.reason: Explicit positive denominator preserves the original exact-rate meaning and validation helpers.

property_mapping.name: processor
property_mapping.reason: An optional native Thing target is useful; no Processor class, worker incarnation or model identity is implied.

property_mapping.name: input
property_mapping.reason: Keep named workload inputs; remove group/preference domains and distinguish the native Action input key.

property_mapping.name: groups
property_mapping.reason: All-or-none grouping/synchronization creates execution guarantees not needed in the thin descriptive interface.

property_mapping.name: preferences
property_mapping.reason: Do not standardize a global lexicographic optimizer or list-order matching protocol.

property_mapping.name: model
property_mapping.target: Native processor input/settings and model/artifact links
property_mapping.reason: Use the actual model format/registry reference, not a mandatory AV InferenceModel manifest and pin closure.

property_mapping.name: contract
property_mapping.target: result FormReference and native result DataSchema
property_mapping.reason: Output schemas and destinations remain; mandatory ResultContract manifests and accepted contract pins do not.

property_mapping.name: allowedPreprocessing
property_mapping.target: Explicit processor interaction schema and model artifact semantics
property_mapping.reason: Do not introduce another permission-profile language; no preprocessing is authorized by omission or by an image-size request.

property_mapping.name: generation
property_mapping.reason: A shared Need/Assignment/status generation protocol is unnecessary for portable desired-input descriptions.

property_mapping.name: presence
property_mapping.reason: Required versus Optional input inclusion is portable and must remain explicit, not defaulted.

property_mapping.name: alternative
property_mapping.reason: Use complete schema branches; no separate identified InputAlternative or selected-alternative RDF machinery.

property_mapping.name: wireTracks
property_mapping.target: Source Offer/Mode facts and explicit processor native input contract
property_mapping.reason: Keep source-side facts separate from application delivery instead of joining two constraint collections by track name.

property_mapping.name: deliveredTracks
property_mapping.target: accepts on the incoming application-side Mode
property_mapping.reason: The actual supplying Thing, including a converter, publishes the representation arriving at the application.

property_mapping.name: constraints
property_mapping.reason: Remove the typed-predicate wrapper hierarchy; native placement/execution constraints remain application-owned.

property_mapping.name: field
property_mapping.reason: Schema keys identify described fields without a separate closed AV field-selector language.

property_mapping.name: lowerInteger
property_mapping.reason: Standard inclusive bounds already express this requirement; units remain those of the described field.

property_mapping.name: upperInteger
property_mapping.reason: No extra AV integer-bound predicate is needed; required prevents missing facts passing hard constraints.

property_mapping.name: lowerRational
property_mapping.target: Explicit application rational comparison or finite exact schema alternatives
property_mapping.reason: JSON Schema cannot express arbitrary quotient bounds; drop generic range matching rather than approximate it.

property_mapping.name: upperRational
property_mapping.target: Explicit application rational comparison or finite exact schema alternatives
property_mapping.reason: No floating-point or numerator-only substitute preserves a general exact rational upper bound.

property_mapping.name: allowedValues
property_mapping.reason: Standard membership tests replace ChoiceConstraint sets; unknown facts still cannot meet required predicates.

property_mapping.name: goal
property_mapping.reason: Preference scoring is not necessary to advertise or request a compatible complete representation.

property_mapping.name: captureIntent
property_mapping.target: Native camera protocol/driver operations and native authorization
property_mapping.reason: Do not redefine observe/request/configure capture permissions; a Still read never implies triggering a new exposure.

property_mapping.name: transformPermissions
property_mapping.reason: Conversion is an explicitly selected processing interaction, not permission inferred from a Need or a generic transform list.

property_mapping.name: selector
property_mapping.reason: Core chooses whole Clips; subclip/sample selection must use the actual protocol or application operation.

property_mapping.name: maxAge
property_mapping.reason: Worst-case age requires named measurement semantics; no universal AV clock/queue evidence framework or freshness default.

property_mapping.name: maxSkew
property_mapping.target: Native synchronization and application timing contract
property_mapping.reason: Pairwise skew cannot be guaranteed by matching metadata or equal clock labels.

property_mapping.name: queues
property_mapping.target: Processor implementation and exposed native settings
property_mapping.reason: Do not require every adapter to serialize all internal queues or pre-branch buffering as AV records.

property_mapping.name: stage
property_mapping.reason: Pipeline stage names are implementation semantics, not universal AV boundary identifiers.

property_mapping.name: capacity
property_mapping.reason: Buffer capacity belongs to the actual queue implementation; omission must not imply unbounded or zero buffering.

property_mapping.name: unit
property_mapping.target: Units defined by the actual processor setting
property_mapping.reason: Do not introduce generic queue-unit records; retained physical AV fields keep their fixed units.

property_mapping.name: overflow
property_mapping.reason: Real upstream support is necessary; no metadata default can establish BlockUpstream feasibility.

property_mapping.name: coveragePolicy
property_mapping.reason: Completeness and intentional-drop guarantees are application-specific, not universal media metadata obligations.

property_mapping.name: gapResponse
property_mapping.reason: Incomplete coverage must be explicit when contracted, without a mandatory queue-policy failure graph.

property_mapping.name: limitMs
property_mapping.reason: Age, skew and queue-residence are different contracts; a generic millisecond field hides scope rather than simplifying it.

property_mapping.name: clock
property_mapping.reason: A common clock/incarnation framework is outside the thin core; equal labels still do not prove synchronization.

property_mapping.name: basis
property_mapping.reason: Capture, presentation and receipt time meanings must be supplied by their real producer, not an AV mapping graph.

property_mapping.name: timeBase
property_mapping.reason: Rational remains for frame rate, not for a mandatory affine clock-record profile.

property_mapping.name: referenceClock
property_mapping.reason: Target clock mappings and validity are real timing behavior, not required vocabulary for application inputs.

property_mapping.name: uncertaintyMs
property_mapping.reason: Remove the generic bound field with its clock framework; missing uncertainty remains unknown, never zero.

property_mapping.name: start
property_mapping.reason: Timeline-relative selection is not core whole-Clip access, and cannot be inferred from a nominal frame rate.

property_mapping.name: end
property_mapping.reason: Exclusive interval edges must follow the selected native operation; no AV selector graph remains.

property_mapping.name: selection
property_mapping.reason: Exact versus covering sample edges are not portable commands automatically supported by a media Form.

property_mapping.name: toleranceMs
property_mapping.reason: Keep tolerance only when a real selection operation defines it; no default AV overcapture allowance.

property_mapping.name: time
property_mapping.reason: Observed instants should use their producer's timestamp semantics, without a universal AV evidence wrapper.

property_mapping.name: document
property_mapping.reason: Explicit retrieval location and effective base remain necessary; rehome from DocumentPin without immutable-byte guarantees.

property_mapping.name: documentKind
property_mapping.target: Native document/media metadata and cache provenance
property_mapping.reason: Publisher versus directory representations remain distinguishable without a mandatory closed pin-kind vocabulary.

property_mapping.name: hexDigest
property_mapping.target: Existing artifact/package/HTTP integrity mechanisms and release manifest
property_mapping.reason: Keep integrity where required by the actual artifact, not as a universal runtime AV property or authenticity claim.

property_mapping.name: pin
property_mapping.reason: Mandatory transitive interpretation/artifact graphs create most reference complexity; ordinary required references still must resolve.

property_mapping.name: expectedThing
property_mapping.target: Native TD id and Form-membership resolution
property_mapping.reason: Offer.source is checked against the located TD's id; avoid a second identity claim attached to a removed pin.

property_mapping.name: operation
property_mapping.reason: Selecting a compatible existing native operation is useful and does not add protocol operations.

property_mapping.name: jsonPointer
property_mapping.reason: Remove the redundant positional selector; nameless legacy TDs need an explicit native adapter, never first-Form fallback.

property_mapping.name: holder
property_mapping.reason: Worker-incarnation ownership is part of the removed generic grant and execution framework.

property_mapping.name: selections
property_mapping.reason: A small input-to-Mode/Form choice record is ordinary application JSON, not mandatory nested AV selections.

property_mapping.name: omitted
property_mapping.reason: An accepting application must account for required inputs, but a universal omissions graph is unnecessary.

property_mapping.name: forms
property_mapping.target: Small FormReference records in native choice payloads and result/destination
property_mapping.reason: Remove the lifecycle-only collection and its adapter-leg requirement; native TD forms remains untouched.

property_mapping.name: requirement
property_mapping.reason: No TrackSelection-to-wire/delivered requirement join remains in the core.

property_mapping.name: assignment
property_mapping.target: Native operation/resource identifier, optional PROV links
property_mapping.reason: Status or run references may use the application's existing job resource without an AV Assignment lifecycle.

property_mapping.name: state
property_mapping.reason: Need activation, runtime status and content completion are different application contracts, not one overloaded AV state field.

property_mapping.name: incarnation
property_mapping.reason: Restart/discontinuity handling belongs to actual protocols; no universal observer/media incarnation ontology.

property_mapping.name: sequence
property_mapping.reason: Do not share one ordinal field across observer observations, media units and lease renewals.

property_mapping.name: observedAt
property_mapping.reason: Status timing need not create an immutable observation with required clocks and grants.

property_mapping.name: validFrom
property_mapping.target: Native external authorization/retention contract if present
property_mapping.reason: A generic grant-start field is unnecessary once LeaseGrant is removed.

property_mapping.name: validUntil
property_mapping.target: Native cache freshness and authorization expiry
property_mapping.reason: Cache freshness and grant expiry are separate mechanisms; no universal AV interval/clock contract.

property_mapping.name: lease
property_mapping.reason: No mandatory initial/current/effect-checked grant graph for descriptions, selections or processing.

property_mapping.name: conditions
property_mapping.reason: Exactly four generic readiness claims are controller policy and disproportionate for a media extension.

property_mapping.name: condition
property_mapping.target: Native application status fields when needed
property_mapping.reason: MediaObserved/ApplicationReady/ModelLoaded/ResultCommitted are not mandatory universal observation categories.

property_mapping.name: conditionState
property_mapping.reason: No four-valued generic claim language; missing facts remain unknown without publishing artificial condition records.

property_mapping.name: evidence
property_mapping.target: Optional PROV/standard metadata links and native receipts
property_mapping.reason: Actual evidence may be linked, but do not require authenticated commit-receipt pins for every result.

property_mapping.name: authority
property_mapping.reason: An AV authority identity is not authorization and should not introduce a new grant framework.

property_mapping.name: scope
property_mapping.reason: Multi-authority effect domains and atomicity are operational contracts outside the descriptive core.

property_mapping.name: fence
property_mapping.target: Actual native scheduler/enforcer if it supports fencing
property_mapping.reason: Delete generic ownership epochs; metadata cannot fence hardware or recall a physical trigger.

property_mapping.name: issues
property_mapping.reason: Keep explicit failure and incompleteness reporting without a mandatory AV Fault collection.

property_mapping.name: code
property_mapping.target: Native error code or application schema
property_mapping.reason: A closed universal AV failure vocabulary is unnecessary and must not replace real protocol errors.

property_mapping.name: committedAt
property_mapping.target: Native durable artifact/receipt semantics when contracted
property_mapping.reason: Result availability or delivery does not imply durability; no universal mandatory commitment timestamp.

external_property_mapping.name: dcterms:identifier
external_property_mapping.core_obligation: Required local name on Track and InputRequirement only
external_property_mapping.reason: Reuse stable component/input names without another AV identifier property or Result output-slot framework.

external_property_mapping.name: dcterms:isVersionOf
external_property_mapping.reason: May express revision lineage; it no longer mandates Need generations or lease-series semantics.

external_property_mapping.name: dcterms:format
external_property_mapping.reason: Use standard format metadata for artifacts; native Form contentType remains authoritative for exchanged content.

external_property_mapping.name: dcterms:conformsTo
external_property_mapping.reason: Do not require AV pinned profiles or treat a conformance link as validation/capability evidence.

external_property_mapping.name: dcterms:description
external_property_mapping.reason: Keep non-secret descriptions without mandatory Fault records; native TD descriptions stay native.

external_property_mapping.name: dcterms:title
external_property_mapping.reason: No AV alias or mandatory PROV Entity wrapper; Thing titles continue to use native TD title.

external_property_mapping.name: dcterms:creator
external_property_mapping.reason: Creator identity is useful metadata, not a processing or permission framework.

external_property_mapping.name: dcterms:publisher
external_property_mapping.reason: Publisher metadata does not confer authorization or prove projected source facts.

external_property_mapping.name: dcterms:license
external_property_mapping.reason: License links remain distinct from native access/security grants.

external_property_mapping.name: dcterms:references
external_property_mapping.reason: Link existing descriptions without requiring transitive AV pins or creating a second endpoint.

external_property_mapping.name: prov:used
external_property_mapping.reason: Use directly on real activities; a Need or selection does not establish consumed inputs.

external_property_mapping.name: prov:wasGeneratedBy
external_property_mapping.reason: No mandatory AV Result/ProcessingRun types; link actual generation only when known.

external_property_mapping.name: prov:wasDerivedFrom
external_property_mapping.reason: Existing PROV suffices for artifact/sample derivation without a universal sample identity graph.

external_property_mapping.name: prov:wasAssociatedWith
external_property_mapping.reason: A Thing, a runtime Agent and learned weights remain different identities, without mandatory AV execution wrappers.

external_property_mapping.name: prov:wasAttributedTo
external_property_mapping.reason: Remove mandatory controller/observer attribution and authorization claims; upstream attribution meaning remains intact.

external_property_mapping.name: prov:startedAtTime
external_property_mapping.reason: Use native or PROV execution time when known; it does not establish media capture time.

external_property_mapping.name: prov:endedAtTime
external_property_mapping.reason: Processing end is not durable commitment; no generic AV receipt dependency.

profile_mapping.name: acquisition-v0.1
profile_mapping.target: ONVIF/GenICam/UVC/native access and media operation semantics
profile_mapping.reason: Do not specify encoder, trigger, owner or camera configuration again; whole-Clip access needs no AV acquisition profile.

profile_mapping.name: adapter-plan-v0.1
profile_mapping.target: Actual processor Thing and its native input/output/settings
profile_mapping.reason: No mandatory implementation qualification, all-queue topology or cost/clock plan document; publish a separate output Offer.

profile_mapping.name: clock-map-v0.1
profile_mapping.target: Native clock/media mapping when an application needs it
profile_mapping.reason: Remove the affine record/evidence framework rather than make it a hidden prerequisite.

profile_mapping.name: resource-config-v0.1
profile_mapping.reason: Complete shared-state equivalence, scope and allocation are native scheduling concerns.

profile_mapping.name: codec-layout-v0.1
profile_mapping.target: Existing codec initialization, media negotiation and native pixel/buffer interfaces
profile_mapping.reason: Keep portable facts but do not define a universal decoder/raw-layout manifest or infer support from codec names.

profile_mapping.name: media-manifest-v0.1
profile_mapping.reason: Retention, file hashes, gaps and access remain actual artifact concerns, not prerequisites for advertising a Still or Clip.

profile_mapping.name: model-manifest-v0.1
profile_mapping.target: Existing model format and artifact/package registry
profile_mapping.reason: Do not recreate tensor/file/runtime/preprocessing declarations in a new mandatory AV manifest.

profile_mapping.name: result-contract-v0.1
profile_mapping.target: Native output/DataSchema plus optional result/destination FormReferences
profile_mapping.reason: Payload schemas, envelopes and native destination inputs do not require a new completion/deduplication/commit protocol.

profile_mapping.name: run-config-v0.1

normalization_decision.target: One complete Mode, never combined facts or tracks from several Modes or named graphs.
normalization_decision.track_identity: Include dcterms:identifier and known representation facts; omit @context, @id, @type, Form, security and backend-private fields.
normalization_decision.controls: Only known exact 0.2 AV controlled IRIs normalize to av:Token. No local-name matching across namespaces.
normalization_decision.schema_dialect_omission: An omitted $schema selects JSON Schema 2020-12 for this draft; every explicit $schema must identify exactly that supported dialect.
normalization_decision.schema_scope: accepts is an object carried with @type @json. Only local self-contained references; never automatic external retrieval. Standard JSON Schema keywords only; unsupported vocabularies/keywords fail explicitly.
normalization_decision.presence: Hard facts need standard required keywords. properties alone does not require presence. Schema default is annotation-only and never fills facts.
normalization_decision.formats: format is annotation-only; this matcher deliberately does not enable automatic format assertions.
normalization_decision.ordering: Track order has no semantic meaning; use contains/items/set-wide tests. Positional prefixItems schemas are explicitly unsupported by this portable matcher.
normalization_decision.rational: Exact positive reduced av:numerator/av:denominator pairs support const/enum; no general rational inequalities, cross-field arithmetic guarantee or rounded FPS.
normalization_decision.boundary: Metadata compatibility is not authorization, availability, decoder/layout/transport qualification or runtime acceptance.
normalization_decision.conversion: JPEG cannot satisfy BGR8 directly. An explicitly exposed interoperable processor output can advertise BGR8 separately; internal cv2 operations need no separate Thing.
